entities.summary: Lyndsey Gerd Gunnulfsen, usually known by her stage name Lynn Gunn, is an American singer and multi-instrumentalist, best known for fronting the rock band PVRIS. She has also collaborated with artists such as Tonight Alive and A Loss for Words.
